meta.title: Explore - Celebrity Book & Movie Recommendations
meta.description: Discover books, movies, and music recommended by 1,000+ celebrities. From historical figures to modern icons — explore their reading lists and cultural tastes.

celebs.metaDescription: Browse 1,000+ celebrities and their recommended books, favorite movies, and music. Find what your favorite figure reads, watches, and listens to.

empty.noFriendsDesc: Follow each other to become friends
empty.noSimilarDesc: Record more content to find users with similar taste

ui.contentMatchDesc: We find users who recorded the same content as you
ui.step1: Count the shared content between you and others
ui.step2: Normalize by total content count for fair comparison
ui.step3: Recommend in order of highest similarity
ui.moreRecordsBetter: The more content you record, the better we can find users with similar taste

hub.trendingSub: The most visited figures over the past month.
hub.rankingSub: The most prolific figures and the top record-holder in each field, all in one place.
hub.personaAnalysisSub: See where influential figures stand across four dispositions (optimism, progressiveness, community, boldness). You can also search by name.
hub.groupDocumentedDesc: Figures who left their lines recorded. Their echoes light the way to your next discovery.
hub.groupThinkersDesc: No consumption records survive, yet the ideas they left behind are works of art in themselves.
hub.deepReadersSub: Figures with 30+ documented records. A wealth of echoes reveals one person's worldview.
hub.topByTypeSub: The most prolific seekers in Books, Film, Games, and Music.
hub.lightCelebsSub: Echoes beyond the record. Their thinking adds new depth to your own appreciation.
hub.factionSub: Curated collections of figures united by a single theme, transcending eras and fields.
hub.allCelebsSub: Freely explore the shelves of every seeker.
hub.personaExtremesSub: Figures with distinct virtues, exceptional abilities, and profound traits. See how their unique characteristics shape their records.

youtube.metaDescription: Library Tour on video — the books great figures actually read. Watch full episodes and one-book shorts in one place.
youtube.intro: Tour the libraries of great figures on video. Full episodes trace one figure's reading life; shorts tell the story of one figure and one book.
youtube.longformSub: Full-length tours through one figure's entire library
youtube.shortsSub: Short videos on the story of a figure and a single book

directory.metaDescription: Browse the complete directory of 1,000+ celebrities with their book recommendations, movie picks, and reading lists.

celebFeed.metaDescription: Real-time feed of celebrity book recommendations, movie reviews, and music picks. See what notable figures are reading now.

topByType.metaDescription: Top 10 rankings by books, movies, games, and music — discover who engages the most in each category.
topByType.sharedDesc: Works enjoyed by 2 or more of the Top {count}.

persona.metaDescription: Meet figures with extreme tendencies across 16 axes — reading volume, diversity, depth, and more.

timelinePage.metaDescription: Explore celebrities by country and era. Discover their recommended books, movies, and music in chronological order.

today.metaDescription: Discover a new celebrity's recommended books, movies, and music every day. See what today's featured figure reads and watches.
